content.summary: A ceramicist's work trousers are verified across detail and full-body views. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity and garment remain fixed. + Every macro detail reconnects to a full view. + Front, side and rear geometry are all shown. + Pose changes do not alter fit or anatomy. + The final full body verifies the product board.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one adult ceramicist in a black shirt and sand-colored work trousers against a pale gray studio. Reconnect each detail to complete front, side and rear standing views. Return to the same ceramicist in a complete standing pose with all garment geometry readable.
required_anchors: One adult identity and garment remain fixed.
Every macro detail reconnects to a full view.
Pose changes do not alter fit or anatomy.
The final full body verifies the product board.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A ceramicist's work trousers are verified across detail and full-body views. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
